name: From Heaven To Hell
source:
Can I really find happiness?" You've spent your entire life miserable. But a miracle happens on your 19th birthday! An angel and a demon suddenly show up to tell you that you're a "very special being." Will this unbelievable encounter turn your life around? Or could it be it's the end of a terrible nightmare?

[From in-app]
translation:
“我真的能找到幸福吗？”你一生都在痛苦中度过，但奇迹在你19岁生日那天发生了！天使和恶魔突然出现，告诉你，你是一个“非常特别的存在”。这次难以置信的邂逅会改变你的生活吗？还是一场可怕噩梦的结束？

[来自应用程序内]
